visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses wearing a red and white horizontal striped t-shirt lies on a brown sofa, holding a red smartphone in one hand and a purple massage stick in the other. He looks bored and sighs, with a traditional calendar on the white wall behind him. (2) The scene cuts rapidly as he begins to wave the massage stick playfully towards the camera while still lying down. (3) He is then seen sitting at an indoor restaurant table with several small bowls of food, holding chopsticks and looking dissatisfied while speaking. (4) He appears at a public transit area or airport with a woman; they both wave at the camera while holding luggage. (5) Back in a bedroom setting, he lies on a bed with a pink blanket, suddenly clutching his left leg in visible pain as if experiencing a cramp, his mouth wide open in a shout. (6) He sits on a couch reading a beauty magazine featuring a woman on the cover, then shifts to playing with a small, fluffy light-brown Pomeranian dog on a bed. (7) A second man in a blue and white striped polo shirt and glasses appears, standing against a yellow curtain backdrop, holding up a smartphone that displays the LINE TV logo and pointing to it. (8) A sequence of screen recordings and trailers follows, showing the LINE TV interface, various movie posters, and clips of actors in dramatic scenes with Chinese subtitles. (9) The first man returns, now lying in bed watching a show on a red smartphone held horizontally. (10) The final phase shows the first man sitting on the floor, petting the small dog affectionately in a brightly lit room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a high-pitched, comic, accented Traditional Chinese, expressing boredom through long sighs and drawn-out vowels over a quiet room tone. (2) A sudden electronic 'sting' triggers a high-tempo, major-mode pop backing track with a strong 4/4 drum machine beat. The speaker begins rapping/singing in time with the music, his voice characterized by high arousal and dramatic inflection changes. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a scene shift, followed by loud shouting as the speaker vocalizes intense physical pain from a cramp, briefly overpowering the BGM. (4) The audio transitions to a more polished, professional male narrator's voice with clear articulation and lower pitch, promoting app features over the continuing upbeat BGM. Frequent digital UI 'clicks' and 'pops' mark transitions between promotional points. (5) The music cuts out abruptly, leaving only the original speaker's voice in a gentle, low-arousal tone as he talks to a pet, with faint indoor ambient rustling sounds audible in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote LINE TV's 10th anniversary and VIP membership deals by using a comedic influencer (Han Han) to contrast a 'boring life' with the entertainment provided by the streaming service. It aims to drive subscriptions through limited-time discounts and feature showcases like dual subtitles.
